verdict.recommendation: DISCARD this mutation. DD 5/15 with 35% min exposure is far too aggressive for an already-weak base (SR=0.209). The base STR_1424 itself was routed to S5 because it failed S4 (delta_sharpe=-0.815, kospi_beat=FALSE). The tail risk x flow combination (R10+CR09) shows structural weakness in Korean markets — CAGR 1.57% over 20+ years is economically meaningless. S3 flagged 'redundant' orthogonality. Recommend: do not pursue further mutations on STR_1424. The R10_Cokurtosis factor may have value as a pure exclusion gate in other strategies but not as a scoring factor.
